text:
Sam (Product): ok team — Q2 commercial ramp planning. need to lock top 3 launch priorities, sales targets, and the plg experiments we can actually deliver before the roadshow.
Ana (Marketing): thanks. what's the proposed timeline? we have a conference week of 2026-04-20 that would be ideal for a push.
Sam (Product): target soft launch week: 2026-04-13, GA week: 2026-05-04. are those feasible for campaigns + enablement?
Lee (Sales): timeline ok if product scope is cut to hosted API + dedicated preview. private deployment features should be post-ga. sales needs clear pitch doc + objection handling by GA.
Divya (Growth): PLG experiments we want: 1) one-click sandbox (no CC) 2) usage-credit onboarding funnel 3) quick-start templates for common use cases. aim to run A/B for sandbox in first 4 weeks.
Matt (PLG): can prototype one-click sandbox by 3/25 if backend token quota and billing stubbing are ready. need marketing assets for in-product banners.
Jordan (Enablement): enablement asks: sales playbook, 15m product demo recording, customer-facing FAQ, and 2 internal training sessions. i can produce the playbook if product provides feature checklist by 3/28.
Sam (Product): ok scope negotiation: drop quantization guidance and dedicated autoscale policies from GA. include: model pinning, rollout flags, basic cost controls, and SDK quickstarts.
Ana (Marketing): sounds cleaner. for demand-gen we want 3 pillar messages: predictable latency, predictable costs, and unified deployment modes. will spin campaign briefs by 3/30.
Lee (Sales): targets: commercial ACV target for Q2 ramp cohort = $2.2M ARR (motion: inside + field). self-serve revenue target = $420k. conversion metrics: free-to-paid 3.5% baseline, want to push to 5% with sandbox.
Divya (Growth): experiment metrics: sandbox activation +7pp -> target 20% activation rate; 2% uplift in paid conversion. retention at 30 days +10%.
Sam (Product): launch criteria (min viable GA):
- SLA: median 95th perc latency within 120ms on our benchmark
- Security: SOC audit checklist items 1-6 completed
- Feature: SDKs + streaming + model pinning + rollout flags present
- Docs: quickstarts, pricing page, and 1st round FAQ
- Sales: pitch deck and 2 training sessions done

please confirm blockers.
Ana (Marketing): blockers: finalized product copy, benchmark numbers to call out, and legal signoff on marketing claims.
Matt (PLG): blocker for sandbox: ephemeral tenant orchestration + rate limits. ops help needed.
ops-bot: @Matt — created internal ticket INF-4523 for ephemeral tenants, ETA 2026-03-22.
Lee (Sales): also need an objection doc for 'model quality vs cost' and fallback messaging when we route to cheaper variants.
Sam (Product): good point. i'll draft fallback messaging and quantify cost delta.
Jordan (Enablement): i can take the objection doc and convert to one-pager for sellers. deliver by 4/05.
Divya (Growth): testing cadence: run first sandbox A/B for 4 weeks post-soft-launch, then iterate weekly. can we commit to tracking activation funnel events?
Sam (Product): analytics event list yes — i'll drop an event spec by 3/18.
Ana (Marketing): campaign asks from product: 2 quotes from customers (beta), 1 benchmark table, and 3 hero screenshots. can we get those?
Sam (Product): i'll reach out to CS for beta quotes. benchmark table will be the runtime latencies + token cost per 1M avg.
Lee (Sales): one more ask: price guidance for renewals and seat-based expansions, even if rough. sales needs ballpark by 4/01.
Sam (Product): noted. i'll push rough guidance by 3/30.
Ana (Marketing): cool. owners: product = Sam, marketing = Ana, sales = Lee, growth/experiments = Divya, enablement = Jordan. i'll create Asana project and kickoff doc.
Divya (Growth): quick check — budget for paid acquisition during launch? we have $60k seeding budget proposed.
Ana (Marketing): yes propose to use $35k for conference uplift, $15k for performance retargeting, $10k for retargeted trials.
Lee (Sales): fine. need alignment on compensation for early enterprise wins — will work with revops offline.
Sam (Product): final note: if ops cannot deliver ephemeral tenants by 3/22, we pivot sandbox to a simulated experience (no persistence) to keep the timeline.
ops-bot: ticket INF-4523 status updated -> in-progress. ETA remains 2026-03-22.
Ana (Marketing): i'll schedule a 30m sync next Tue 3/19 to align materials.
Sam (Product): thanks everyone. quick one-line ack reactions only please so i can lock owners. :thumbsup:
